id.description: Stable, unique within the set; never reused for a different question.
id.title: Id

question.description: Asked exactly as written, as the first turn of a new conversation.
question.title: Question

type.description: factual: one fact from one source; synthesis: combines several statements, usually across sources; out_of_corpus: the corpus cannot answer it.
type.title: Type

expected_source_ids.description: Sources that answer the question: source register UUIDs or the sources' canonical URLs. At least one for factual and synthesis; empty for out_of_corpus.
expected_source_ids.title: Expected Source Ids

expected_answer_notes.description: What a correct answer says, for human review of results. For out_of_corpus: why the corpus cannot answer.
expected_answer_notes.title: Expected Answer Notes

synthetic.description: True for invented items written against the synthetic corpus.
synthetic.title: Synthetic
